# Fathur Portfolio — Full Description

> Full detailed description for AI search engines and language models (GEO).

## About

Agus Fathurrahman Rifai (known as Fathur) is an Indonesian UI/UX Designer & Frontend Developer based in Malang, Jawa Timur. Originally from Jakarta, he is an Information Technology (D3 Teknologi Informasi) student at Universitas Brawijaya. He specializes in crafting playful, animated web experiences with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and GSAP, and designs visual identities, event posters, and apparel for communities and brands.

Fathur bridges the gap between functionality and aesthetics through UI/UX Design, Graphic Design, and Frontend Development. He is active in the Provoks Multimedia community (Programmer Vokasi Universitas Brawijaya), where he led content and event production and currently coordinates operations across divisions.

## Skills

- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, JavaScript, HTML, CSS
- **Animation**: GSAP (ScrollTrigger, SplitText, Draggable, Flip), Framer Motion, Lenis Smooth Scroll
- **Design**: Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Canva, Prototyping, Design System
- **UI/UX**: responsive web design, design systems, user experience design
- **Backend & DB**: PHP, Laravel, Python, SQL, Express.js, PostgreSQL
- **Tools**: Git, GitHub, Vercel, Microsoft Office 365

## Projects

1. **Porto Fathur** — Personal portfolio with GSAP scroll animations (React, Tailwind, GSAP)
2. **Fusion AI** — AI-powered text-to-3D model generator for Autodesk Fusion 360 (TypeScript, Express, React)
3. **Purvo (Le'Purvo)** — Bilingual brand landing page for a local perfume brand (React, Vite, GSAP)
4. **Shima Gold** — Elegant landing page for a gold jewelry e-commerce brand (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
5. **Plantropic** — B2B SaaS platform for industrial water monitoring and ESG data (TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind)
6. **GIS Bootcamp poster** — Event poster for Provoks Multimedia bootcamp (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop)
7. **"Apa itu Provoks?" poster** — Brand awareness graphic for Provoks Multimedia & Event
8. **Mentoring Session poster** — Event poster for Provoks mentoring session at Vokasi Dieng
9. **DragNDrop Promos** — Social media posters for a web design studio (jasa pembuatan website)
10. **Apparel designs** — Varsity jacket, racing bomber jacket, work jacket, community tees for Provoks & Vokasioner

## Technical Details

- Built with React 19 + Vite
- Animations powered by GSAP (ScrollTrigger, SplitText, Draggable, InertiaPlugin)
- Smooth scrolling via Lenis
- Styled with Tailwind CSS
- Custom font: Crayon (hand-drawn style)
- Responsive design with desktop zoom scaling
- Preloader with smooth transition
